sar.narrative: Customer C05061, holder of card C05061-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2017-01-13 and 2017-01-14, 2 transaction(s) totalling $1,338.74 were identified as unauthorised on that card, the earliest being transaction 3660107 and the transaction that triggered review being 3660108 for $447.95. The activity was conducted through the online channel in billing region 492.0. The transactions originated from device profile 'RCT6303W87M7 Build/MRA58K | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop', which the issuer's identity record marks 'New' for this account, reached through an anonymous proxy. The purchases were made without the physical card, from a device with no prior history on the account. Closed investigation CC-2420 recorded confirmed fraud on comparable activity. The issuer assesses the probability of fraud at 0.91 on the evidence set out above. Total suspicious amount: $1,338.74.
